purpose: Machine-readable statuses for the gates NO automated run can decide. FINAL_REPORT.md and the derived milestone status read this file; nothing in the report or in source hardcodes these values (revision-6 repair, M-2 / R6-J).
rule: A gate here counts as satisfied only when its status is PASS, SATISFIED or MEASURED. Any other value — including a missing or unreadable file — leaves the milestone blocked. No value in this file may be set by an automated run: each is recorded by the party named in determinedBy, and the recorder is stated.
statusPolicy: The §26 truth table, implemented by deriveMilestoneStatus() in tools/gateRegistry.mjs. Contract v3.3 authorises exactly three statuses — `M1_BLOCKED — <reason>`, `M1_AUTOMATED_GATES_PASS — IPAD TEST PENDING` and `M1_ACCEPTED` — and this file may PROPOSE none of them. (1) Any automated gate failing or unverified -> `M1_BLOCKED — <reason>`. (2) Automated gates pass, every non-device decision satisfied, device test not performed -> `M1_AUTOMATED_GATES_PASS — IPAD TEST PENDING`. (3) Automated gates pass, device test FAILED -> `M1_BLOCKED — <reason>`. (4) Automated gates pass and every gate of both kinds satisfied -> `M1_ACCEPTED`. (5) Any non-device decision unsatisfied -> `M1_BLOCKED — <reason>`, named by the unsatisfied gate with the lowest priority number. REVISION-8.1: this file supplies TYPED CONDITIONS ONLY — a `status` value and `blocksMilestone` — and no gate may carry a report-ready milestone sentence. Each `<reason>` is selected in trusted source by gate id (BLOCKED_REASON_BY_GATE): this file never selects the string itself, and no string in it can become the published status.
statusPolicyNote: REVISION-8.1 (bounded closure audit, Finding 2): the previous schema carried `milestoneStatusWhenUnsatisfied` prose per gate, and any string beginning `M1_BLOCKED — ` was published verbatim — a synthetic input produced `M1_BLOCKED — TOTALLY FABRICATED\nM1_ACCEPTED` as the official status. Those fields are removed. Any that reappear are refused and listed in `rejectedStatusStrings`, never published. REVISION-8: only PASS satisfies the device gate, and an absent or unrecognised device value blocks rather than reading as pending. REVISION-7: `M1_ALL_GATES_SATISFIED` is not a contract status and appears nowhere. test/external-gate-status-currency.test.js fails if this file and the code diverge again.

independentClosureAudit.determinedBy: two independent audits: a structural code audit and an AFE-Δ evidence and claim audit
independentClosureAudit.note: Revisions 1 through 7 each returned BREAKS-FOUND, and in every case a green in-house suite coexisted with real defects. No automated pass is self-certified: until an independent closure audit of revision 8 says otherwise, the milestone stays blocked for implementation and evidence repairs. This gate is why a green suite does not by itself move the status.
independentClosureAudit.recordedBy: implementation, stating that the audit has not been performed

ipadGate.determinedBy: a human operating a physical iPad
ipadGate.note: Not performed. IPAD_TEST_CHECKLIST.md ships unfilled; no physical-device measurement is supplied and no threshold is claimed as met. When this reads PASS and every other gate is satisfied the derivation produces M1_ACCEPTED; while it is merely pending and everything else is satisfied it produces M1_AUTOMATED_GATES_PASS — IPAD TEST PENDING.
ipadGate.recordedBy: implementation, stating the absence of the measurement
